div.p: ADR-010 (chosen) — Inngest is canonical for run state (one fn per Lead); local DB holds only outputs; nurture_sequences dropped

g.text: one fn instance per Lead · concurrency {key: leadId, limit: 1} · sleeps to cadence boundary
